answer.rationale: Use the confirmed SMB signup-simplification result: activation rose 9%, qualified revenue rose 4%, and 30-day retention was nearly unchanged. Avoid promotional pricing despite competitive pressure because the recovered experiment showed 12% lower retention and explicitly rejected discounting as a sustainable-growth strategy. Limit this to an SMB experiment because the onboarding result has not been replicated in other segments and may not directly reduce churn among existing accounts.
